data.name: Muqeetah
data.gender_notes: Muqeetah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'q-t-t', meaning to seek protection. The name Muqeetah signifies a person who seeks refuge and safety. The name Muqeetah carries the meaning “Seeking protection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqeetah usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the protection and guidance of Allah.
data.etymology: Muqeetah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seeking protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqeetah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مقيتة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من قيت ومعناه الحافظة أو القائمة على حفظ الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقيتة هو اسم مؤنث يعود في أصله إلى الفعل قيت الذي يعني الحفاظ أو القيام على الشيء. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بمعاني الحفظ والرعاية. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالقيم الإسلامية، حيث يعكس الاسم صفات الحافظة أو القائمة على حفظ الشيء، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة معنوية عالية.

in_urdu.name: مقیتہ
in_urdu.meaning: مقیتہ نام کا مطلب ہے محافظ یا چیز کو محفوظ رکھنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقیتہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل قيت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے محفوظ کرنا یا کسی چیز کی نگہداشت کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ نام محافظ یا چیز کو محفوظ رکھنے والی کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ محافظ اور نگہبان کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو کہ اسلامی اقدار میں بہت اہم ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुक़ीताह
in_hindi.meaning: मुक़ीताह नाम का अर्थ है रक्षक या चीज़ को सुरक्षित रखने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुक़ीताह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रियापद قيت (क़ाय्यत) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षित करना या किसी चीज़ की देखभाल करना। हिंदी में, यह नाम रक्षक या चीज़ को सुरक्षित रखने वाली के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह रक्षक और संरक्षक के गुणों को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी मूल्यों में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण हैं।

in_pashto.name: مقيته
in_pashto.meaning: مقيته نوم دى ساته د حافظې يا د شىء د محفوظى په معنى
in_pashto.long_meaning: مقيته يوه مونثه نوم ده چې د عربي ژبې د قيت فعل څخه اخيستل شوى، چې د محفوظ کولو يا د شىء د پاملرنې په معنى دی. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د حافظې يا د شىء د محفوظى په معنى کارول کېږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دود کې مهم ګڼل کېږي ځکه چې د حافظ او محفوظ کوونکي صفات ښيي، کوم چې په اسلامي ارزښتونو کې ډېر مهم دي.

in_english.name: Muqeetah
in_english.meaning: Muqeetah means protector or one who preserves something
in_english.long_meaning: Muqeetah is a feminine name derived from the Arabic root 'q-w-y' (قيت), which means to protect, preserve, or take care of something. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the qualities of a guardian or protector. Muqeetah reflects the values of responsibility, care, and vigilance. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to signify strength and reliability. Today, Muqeetah is used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person who is dependable and protective.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muqeetah holds a significant cultural meaning as it signifies someone who seeks protection and shelter in times of need. In Islamic tradition, seeking refuge or protection under the flag of Allah (Sword of Allah, Crescent of Allah, etc.) is highly regarded. The importance of this germinates from the hadiths where the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) teaches us that the person seeking protection gets surrounded by the shield of Allah, whereas the one who offers protection gains the blessings of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muqeetah also holds a profound spiritual significance. It serves as a reminder that every human being is in need of protection and shelter, not just from physical harm but also emotional, mental, and spiritual odds. In this sense, Muqeetah can be seen as a constant reminder to seek refuge and solace in Allah, and to protect and cherish the sanctity of those around us, for we are all Muqeetah, seeking protection in the Love and Grace of Allah. Furthermore, it can act as a reminder to extend that same protection and shelter to others, for it is through kindness and compassion that we truly connect with the divine spirit.
